emails.subject: Q3 deck before Thursday's board hour
emails.preview: Harborline needs the deck in the data room before Thursday 9:00 CT.
emails.body:
Jun — Thursday's board hour is still 9:00 CT. Please drop the Q3 deck in the Harborline data room before then, and put the Austin opening slip and the Northline allocation on page one. I don't need a new narrative, just the numbers you already have.

Priya Raman
Harborline Capital

emails.subject: Austin walkthrough clashes with the foundry call
emails.preview: The floor is free Monday morning if we move today's 1:15.
emails.body:
Jun — the Austin floor walk is still on your Friday at 1:15, and Northline is on the same hour. I can hold the store at Monday 10:00 CT instead. The fixtures will be in place either way. Tell me which hour you want and I'll move the crew.

Ellis Cho
VP, Stores

emails.subject: November GPU allocation, held not cut
emails.preview: Northline is holding 1,200 boards. They are not cancelled.
emails.body:
Jun — confirming what I'll say on the 1:00 CT call. November's 1,200 boards are held, not cancelled. We can ship 800 in the first week if Voltline names a dock by Tuesday. The rest follows the week after. No price change.

Henrik Dahl
Northline Foundry

emails.subject: Hold for the Head of Retail finalist
emails.preview: 11:00 today is still tentative until you accept.
emails.body:
Jun — the Head of Retail finalist is on your calendar at 11:00 CT as a tentative hold. People has the scorecard. Accept the hold if you're in, or decline and I'll send the panel a new hour. The candidate is already in Austin.

Naomi Ivers
People

emails.subject: Tonight, or a morning next week?
emails.preview: Dinner at 7 is easy to move. A morning would be better.
emails.body:
Jun — I still have dinner at 7:00 CT tonight. Looking at your Friday, that is a late one on top of the board prep. I can take a morning next week instead and leave tonight clear. Your call.

Samir

emails.subject: Wordmark filing, no action today
emails.preview: Counsel files Monday. Nothing for you to sign today.
emails.body:
Jun — the Voltline wordmark filing goes in Monday. Counsel has the specimen. There is nothing for you to sign today. I'll bring the receipt to the Thursday dry run.

Adele March
Legal

emails.subject: Embargo check at 3:30
emails.preview: The note stays inside until Monday 6:00 CT.
emails.body:
Jun — the launch note is still under embargo until Monday 6:00 CT. The 3:30 check is only to confirm the quote on page two. Nothing goes out today.

Lila Ortega
Press desk

emails.subject: Friday visitor list
emails.preview: Harborline's associate and the retail finalist are on the list.
emails.body:
Jun — today's visitor list is Priya Raman's associate (Harborline) at 9:20 and the retail finalist at 10:45. Both are badged for the glass room. No one else.

Ren Park
Workplace
